# Onboard knowledge base
Only these documents may be used by the LLM. Add short, cited guides (one topic per file), for example:
`sleep-and-fatigue.md`, `radiation-spe-shelter.md`, `cabin-co2.md`, `bone-muscle-exercise.md`, `orthostatic-intolerance.md`, `infection-checklist.md`, `behavioral-health-support.md`.
Each file: title, when it applies, steps, escalation criteria, source URL (e.g. NASA HRP pages), and the line "Reviewed by: (name or TODO)".
